# stb (vendored, test only)

`stb_image_write.h` v1.16 and `stb_image.h` v2.30 from
<https://github.com/nothings/stb> at commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`, unmodified. The screen tests
use them to write the rendered screens as PNG files and to read the
reference PNGs back. They are not part of the firmware.

Licence: MIT or public domain (Unlicense), at your choice; the text is at
the end of each header. REUSE.toml records this.
